surprises: AMGT_HARVST-D1-W183-S1: the order's names list has no entry for the scheduler's inline IAM policy; the first draft typed a -run suffix that the naming gate raised, and the commit 5a0fcc751b takes builder output (policy, scheduler), so the names check reads twelve literals.
AMGT_HARVST-D1-W183-S2: aws_scheduler_schedule takes no tags in the pinned AWS provider, so the order's Name tag cannot be set on the schedule; it carries its builder name in its name argument.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W183-S3: the two required variables made every plan and apply of the harvest root fail without the two -var flags (measured: rc 1, No value for required variable). Amendments 1 and 2 remove that by defaults and the two flags; the row's disposition is the issuer's to set.
AMGT_HARVST-D1-W183-S4: the buildspec's digest readback needs ecr:DescribeImages, which the push-only ECR grant list did not carry; it is added to the same statement on the same repository ARN.
AMGT_HARVST-D1-W183-S5: the s3.tf header says the store is declared at opal-data-research; the resource and the plan say opal-data-harvest, so the header is stale. Seen while reading; not acted on.
AMGT_HARVST-D1-W183-S6: this worktree is sparse (org/surprise_channel is skip-worktree), so the channel schema was readable only from the CLOUD ref.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W183-S7: a refused plan (run flag on, build flag off) prints 'Plan: 9 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.' before the precondition error, so the first Plan: line of a refused plan reads as adds; nothing is applied.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W183-S8: a refused plan on an input variable (schedule_state=ON, a validation failure) also prints a partial 'Plan: 15 to add' summary before its error; with S7, neither refusal's Plan: line is the verdict. Nothing is applied.
